standby:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Edit target: the attached exact ORCA LINK operator sprite, already oriented correctly. This is an animation production task. Produce ONE eight-frame animation contact sheet, EXACTLY 4 columns by 2 rows of equal SQUARE cells, read left to right then top to bottom. Prefer a 2048x1024 canvas. Real transparent RGBA alpha, no painted checkerboard. Each cell has identical camera, scale, coordinates and 6% clear padding. Full ahoge, tail, skirt, legs, keyboard and mouse visible in every cell.
Preserve the SAME existing girl, face shape, eye design, bangs, charcoal-to-silver hair, white technical jacket, black sleeves, dark skirt and orca tail. Preserve the delicate thin dark anime outlines and restrained grayscale cel shading with pale skin. No new costume details or redesigned face.
She faces SCREEN RIGHT in a three-quarter seated pose. Her NEAR anatomical RIGHT hand uses the white foreground mouse in the lower right; her FAR anatomical LEFT hand uses the keyboard behind it, upper right. Do not mirror. Exactly two anatomically connected arms and two hands.
Keep keyboard and mouse shape, scale, angle and position invariant, even when a hand leaves a device. Keep seated body, pelvis, shoulders, legs, tail, hair and head silhouette fixed unless the action explicitly permits tiny head motion. Never move the entire sprite to follow a hand. No zoom, body sway, camera rotation, floating hands, extra fingers, clipping or new objects.
No text, labels, borders, grid strokes, scenery, desk, chair, monitor, symbols, particles, glow, sweat drops, motion marks or external shadows. This is eight near-identical cels of ONE anchored character, not eight variations.
ACTION: Quiet standby blink. Change ONLY the eye and eyelids; freeze all other features. All eight frames must have the exact same head contour, mouth, hair, torso, arms, hands and devices.
Cel 0: EXACT input neutral, eye fully open.
Cel 1: upper eyelid lowers one third.
Cel 2: eyelid lowers two thirds.
Cel 3: eyelid gently fully closed.
Cel 4: same softly closed eye.
Cel 5: eyelid reopens to two thirds closed.
Cel 6: eyelid reopens to one third closed.
Cel 7: EXACT duplicate of cel 0.
Use coherent small in-between shapes, no head tilt or expression morph.

syncing.description: Open-eye holds share the neutral eye exactly. A single matched half-close, close, half-reopen sequence provides the connection blink.
